name: @powerhousedao/vetra-cloud-client
description: Environment-agnostic Vetra Cloud communication: GraphQL reads, the VetraCloudEnvironment document-model controller, and signed mutation sequences. Source-only internal package: consumed by vetra-cli (Node) and vetra-app (browser), each of which bundles this source into its own build. Not published; each consumer injects its own bearer-token source and signer.
